help.0.title: START PLAYING
help.0.body: CouchDoom reads the games you already have in DoomRunner, ZDL, or Doom Launcher, and leaves those setups as you made them. It can also show games found by GZDoom, UZDoom, or VKDoom. Pick a game and play.
help.1.title: CAN'T FIND YOUR GAMES?
help.1.body: CouchDoom usually finds your launcher automatically. If it finds more than one, choose the one you want. If your games still aren't listed, open the menu, choose “Choose launcher”, then “Find it myself…” to browse for your launcher or source port. You can also drop its folder onto the CouchDoom window.
help.2.title: BROWSE THE LIST
help.2.body: The selected game stays highlighted while its artwork and details appear beside the list. Select a group heading to see its games and open or collapse it; you can also click the small marker beside a heading. The Section hint jumps from group to group. On a group heading, the bottom hint expands or collapses every group at once.
help.3.title: SEARCH AND FAVORITES
help.3.body: Search by game or group name. Matching games stay visible even when their group is folded. Mark games as favorites to keep them together near the top of the list. The hints along the bottom show the controls for your keyboard or controller.
help.4.title: GAME DETAILS
help.4.body: A game may show its title art, music, description, or a readme. Some games include a colorful end screen called ENDOOM. Choose Info to see these extras when they're available.
help.5.title: MENU AND MUSIC
help.5.body: The Menu hint opens the menu: refresh the list, turn title music or menu sounds on and off, show a Recently played group, change Colors or Language, or choose another launcher. Title music plays when the selected game includes some; if you hear none, that game may not have any, or Title music is off.
help.6.title: IF SOMETHING DOESN'T WORK
help.6.body: If a game lists Problems in its details, CouchDoom can't find something it needs, such as the engine, the IWAD, or a mod file. Check that your launcher still opens the game on its own, then choose “Refresh list” in the menu. If your system warns you the first time you open CouchDoom, allow it only if you downloaded it from the official GitHub releases page.
help.7.title: REPORT A BUG
help.7.body: Choose Help & Feedback at the top of this guide, or its hint below, to open CouchDoom's GitHub issues. Search there first; someone may have reported it already. In a new report, say what you were doing, what you expected, and what happened, and include your version (v{version}) and the game or launcher involved. A screenshot helps, and so does an excerpt from the log at {log}. Remove personal file paths before sharing.
help.8.title: ABOUT
help.8.body: CouchDoom is made by KrisEnigma. Thanks for playing!
